label: Pre-encounter — the Lantern Feast, interrupted
mood: hostly alarm, still hoping the guest leaves

recentEvents.value: The wall-bells rang during the lantern lighting; families are being walked home between songs.
An armed stranger came through the gate during the best night of the year and has not lowered his weapon.

unresolvedConflicts.value: An armed stranger who understands every word and keeps coming — through a festival, toward the lantern lines.

temporaryObjective.value: Get the guest to lower his weapon, see the festival, and turn back — in that order, if lucky.
